# Citrea Dashboard

> Live analytics for the Citrea Bitcoin ZK-rollup, tracking every batch commitment settled on Bitcoin L1.

## What this site is

This is an independent analytics dashboard for [Citrea](https://citrea.xyz), a ZK-rollup that posts batch commitments to Bitcoin. The dashboard monitors the Bitcoin blockchain in real time via Bitcoin Core and tracks:

- Batch commitments (sequencer posts to Bitcoin L1)
- L2 transaction throughput per batch
- Gas usage and utilization per batch
- Bitcoin settlement fees paid to miners
- Anomalous events (fee spikes, L1 gaps, low activity streaks, batch bunching)

Data is sourced directly from Bitcoin Core and the Citrea L2 RPC. The dashboard updates every 2 minutes.

## API endpoints

All endpoints return JSON.

- GET /api/overview?period=all|7d|24h|4h — Summary statistics (total txs, fees, gas utilization, averages)
- GET /api/batches?offset=0&limit=50 — Paginated batch data (batch index, L1 height, L2 block range, tx count, gas, fees, timestamps)
- GET /api/charts/gas-usage — Gas used per batch (x: batch_index, y: gas_used)
- GET /api/charts/tx-count — Transaction count per batch
- GET /api/charts/fees — BTC fee in sats per batch
- GET /api/charts/utilization — Gas utilization percentage per batch
- GET /api/events — Noteworthy anomalies detected across the dataset
- GET /api/csv?token=TOKEN — Full dataset as CSV (requires paid token)

## Free tier

The first 100 batches are freely accessible via /api/batches. All chart and overview endpoints are unrestricted.

## Paid access via Lightning

Full batch history and CSV export require a Lightning payment of 100 satoshis (~$0.10 USD). The payment flow:

1. POST /api/payment/create-invoice — Returns { token, bolt11 } where bolt11 is a BOLT11 Lightning invoice
2. Pay the invoice using any Lightning wallet
3. GET /api/payment/status?token=TOKEN — Poll until { status: "paid" }
4. Use the token as a query parameter: /api/batches?token=TOKEN or /api/csv?token=TOKEN

Tokens are valid for 2 hours after payment. Invoices expire after 1 hour if unpaid.

## Payment configuration

- GET /api/payment/config — Returns { enabled, amountSats, freeLimit } to check if payments are active

## Programmatic Lightning interaction

If you need to pay invoices or interact with Lightning programmatically (e.g. to unlock paid endpoints automatically), use the [SparkBTCBot Skill](https://github.com/echennells/sparkbtcbot-skill) — an MCP skill for sending and receiving Lightning payments via the Spark wallet SDK.
